Kageaki(Good. You can reach me?)

From the feel of her metal-echo, Muramasa was roughly three hundred meters away.
A little far to cross without catching the soldiers’ eyes. But the red spider knew concealment. For her—

ja.text:
金打声の感覚から、村正との距離はおよそ三百米メートル。
　兵士の目を掻い潜って踏破するにはやや長い間だが、
隠形の技を心得た赤蜘蛛ムラマサならば――

en.html: Muramasa《Of course I can! All these days they have treated me like funazushi—fish packed away to ferment! So much frustration they have preserved for me. If I do not let it out now, then WHEN, haan?!》

en.html:
No leisure for another round of useless talk. Dozens of footsteps were already coming toward this room.

What happens to a prisoner after a failed escape? I wished to keep my education incomplete on that point. Not an instant to waste.

ja.html:
重ねて無駄口を叩く余裕はなかった。
　この部屋に向かって殺到する、数十人規模の足音を
既に耳孔は捉えている。

　脱走を試みて失敗した捕虜の運命なるものについて
無知でいるためには、寸暇を惜しんで動くしかない。
